body: VietJet is due back in a London court on November 13, 2026, over roughly $250 million it owes aircraft lessor FW Aviation, in a dispute over four leased Airbus A321s. At issue is whether the Vietnamese airline owes additional sums on the aircraft. VietJet said it had lined up the money and aimed to pay by the hearing date, one of two people familiar with the matter told Reuters, but other reporting has challenged that account, saying the airline was still pursuing its case while remaining open to a settlement.

The four A321s have been back in the lessor's hands for nearly four years. VietJet took delivery of the aircraft in 2018 and 2019 and grounded them during the pandemic; the leases ended in October 2021. FW Aviation sued the following year and recovered all four jets by December 2022, but VietJet still owed rent and lease termination payments. In April 2025, the UK High Court ordered VietJet to pay about $181.5 million. The airline paid about $2 million the following month, and interest and costs have since pushed the debt to roughly $250 million.

On October 15, 2026, the UK Commercial Court granted FW Aviation a freeze order that restricts how VietJet can deal with assets outside Vietnam, including its rights to aircraft it has ordered. The judge ruled that VietJet had transferred nearly all the value of its aircraft order book as of December 2024 to a related company, raising the risk that creditors would be unable to collect. A second order on October 22 gave two court-appointed receivers the power to accept new aircraft on VietJet's behalf or direct manufacturers to deliver them to a third party. The airline has more than 500 jets on order from Airbus and Boeing, and Reuters' sources said VietJet expects to receive its first A330neo and A321XLR within weeks of resolving the dispute.
en.summary: VietJet is due in a London court on November 13 over roughly $250 million it owes lessor FW Aviation in a dispute over four leased Airbus A321s, with the airline saying it has lined up the money while other reporting questions that account.
en.title: VietJet heads back to UK court over $250 million aircraft debt dispute

body: 越捷航空將於2026年11月13日在倫敦法院出庭，處理積欠飛機出租方FW Aviation約2.5億美元的債務，爭議核心是這家越南航空公司是否還須為4架租賃的空中巴士A321支付額外款項。據兩名知情人士之一向路透社表示，越捷航空稱已備妥款項、目標在開庭日前支付；但另有報導對此說法提出質疑，稱該公司仍在打官司，同時對和解持開放態度。
這4架A321已回到出租方手中近4年。越捷航空於2018年及2019年接收這批飛機，疫情期間將其停飛，租約於2021年10月到期。FW Aviation於次年提告，並於2022年12月前收回全部4架飛機，但越捷航空仍積欠租金與租約終止費用。英國高等法院於2025年4月裁定越捷航空支付約1.815億美元，該公司於翌月支付約200萬美元，其後利息與費用使債務總額升至約2.5億美元。

英國商事法院於2026年10月15日批准FW Aviation的凍結令，限制越捷航空處置越南境外資產的方式，包括其對已訂購飛機的權利。法官認定，越捷航空已將截至2024年12月訂單簿的幾乎全部價值轉移給一家關聯公司，使債權人面臨無法受償的風險。10月22日的第二道命令授權兩名法院指定接管人代越捷航空接收新機，或指示製造商將飛機交付第三方。越捷航空向空中巴士與波音訂購逾500架飛機，路透社消息人士稱，該公司預期在糾紛解決後數週內接收首架A330neo與A321XLR。
zh.summary: 越捷航空將於11月13日在倫敦法院就積欠出租方FW Aviation約2.5億美元的4架A321租機債務出庭，航空公司稱已備妥款項、力拚在開庭前支付，但另有報導對此說法提出質疑。
